spec.name: INT1 reg+bands+rt
spec.rationale: structure's best setup + nowcast's best features

spec.name: INT3 reg+rt+dir+blend nobands
spec.rationale: same without bands, to measure the band contribution with rich features

spec.name: INT4 int2+wind_hat
spec.rationale: INT2's real-time gains concentrate in steps 1-4, while wind_hat (per-step-band day-ahead wind-error estimate) was the only weather addition that improved all four metrics on both folds (pinball_B 6.70 vs INT2's 6.80), so it should complement the stack at steps 5-16+ where INT2 is weakest.

spec.name: INT5 int2+causal0.2
spec.rationale: Causal averaging with the o-1h origin gave a small but consistent gain (~0.1-0.5%) in the structure agent's runs at w<=0.2, and since scoring rewards small consistent gains it is a low-risk single-change addition to the full INT2 stack.

spec.name: INT6 int2+band17-40
spec.rationale: Steps 17-40 currently fall back to the pooled model; giving them a dedicated refit extends the banding mechanism that already delivered -7% MAE at steps 1-4 and should help pinball and direction at the long horizons where no band-specific model exists yet.

spec.name: INT7 int5+blend0.7
spec.rationale: Direction Brier has the largest relative headroom and the blend weight has never been varied since 0.6 was set; probing 0.7 tests whether more history weight keeps improving direction on both folds with bounded downside.

spec.name: INT8 int5+maxfeat0.8
spec.rationale: Feature bagging is an untested regularization axis on a wide feature set; decorrelating boosting stages often yields small simultaneous gains on MAE, pinball and both Briers that transfer across folds.

spec.name: INT9 int5+temp
spec.rationale: Exploration: weather agents show temp gives the best pinball_B on the board and helps direction_A, and unlike wind_hat (which broke spike Brier B) it is orthogonal to the rt wind-error features, so it is the safest untested combination with the champion spec.
